featured_projects.name: Transformer Language Model From Scratch
featured_projects.one_line_purpose: Build and train a small autoregressive language model from the core Transformer architecture.
featured_projects.description: Built a 7.7M-parameter autoregressive Transformer from scratch with custom BPE tokenization and an end-to-end training pipeline.
featured_projects.technical_highlight: Implemented the core Transformer language-model pipeline rather than relying solely on a hosted LLM API.
